note: WITNESSES — the other prints and editions a reading was decided from. Held verbatim beside the transcription so a rule's evidence is in the library, not only on the internal shelf.

witnesses.name: porphyry-select-works-taylor-1823
witnesses.why: Taylor's Select Works of Porphyry (1823) carries the same translation of the same treatise — the parallel that decides a reading where its own text is clean.
